name: Jayhawk
subtitle: 5-out motion: pass, cut, fill
goal: Keep the floor spread and keep moving: pass, cut, fill.
options: Best: the cutter for a layup. Next: attack the open lane the cutter leaves behind.

steps.note: Cut: 1 cuts hard to the rim, hands ready for the ball back.
Fill: 3 fills the top, 5 fills the wing, and 1 goes out to the open corner.
Same thing again: 2 passes to 3, then cuts to the rim.
Fill again: 4 fills the wing and 2 goes out to the corner. Keep it going.
